title: AgentStudio WebMCP Toolset
description: Registered WebMCP tools on document.modelContext for OpenAI WebMCP Challenge

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search product catalog in active store node with keyword query and filters.

query.description: Product search keyword (e.g. headphones, keyboard, oled)

tools.name: modify_cart
tools.description: Add or remove products from the active customer shopping cart session.

productId.description: Unique product ID (e.g. prod-1 for Apex Ultra ANC Headphones, prod-2 for Quantum Keyboard, prod-3 for OLED Monitor)

tools.name: apply_discount
tools.description: Apply promotional coupon or agent-negotiated discount percentage to cart.

tools.name: get_workspace_state
tools.description: Get current visual canvas state including all nodes, data, and edge connections.

tools.name: create_canvas_element
tools.description: Spawn a new node card on the infinite visual canvas.

tools.name: update_canvas_element
tools.description: Mutate properties, title, theme, or state of an existing canvas node.

tools.name: delete_canvas_element
tools.description: Destructively remove a node from the canvas (Requires human confirmation).

tools.name: query_edge_telemetry
tools.description: Query Cloudflare edge request metrics, RPS, and anomaly logs.

tools.name: generate_react_component
tools.description: Synthesize interactive React 19 UI component with Tailwind CSS.

tools.name: triage_support_tickets
tools.description: Auto-classify customer tickets and dispatch escalation webhooks.
